_meta.description: Golden question/context pairs for component-level evaluation of the generator, in isolation from the retriever.
_meta.no_ideal_answer: Neither metric reads an expected answer. Faithfulness compares the answer to the context; answer relevancy compares it to the question.
_meta.context_is_verbatim: Chunk text copied from atlas_mine_v01 at build time, byte-identical to what is indexed.
_meta.caveat: The context reflects the chunking live when this was built. It stays valid for measuring the generator, because the text is frozen here -- but after a re-chunk it no longer describes what retrieval would return, and must not be read as though it does.
_meta.excludes: The five missing_data refusal questions. A refusal makes almost no claims, so faithfulness scores it trivially. Abstention is a separate concern with its own golden file.
